xp1.title: Apprenticeship - Master's in Software Engineering
xp1.desc: Design, development, and marketing of e-commerce & logistics software solutions
xp1.mission1: Design and development of the public Shopify app Location Priority (Order Routing & Stock Balance) using Laravel, React, Inertia, Redis, and App Bridge.
xp1.mission2: Event-driven architecture integrated with the Shopify API: webhook event ingestion and mapping to supervised asynchronous queue jobs.
xp1.mission3: Product marketing and outreach strategy: execution of Shopify Ads campaigns, YouTube demonstration videos, and Instagram posts.
xp1.mission4: Maintenance and enhancement of multichannel synchronization modules (Shopify, PrestaShop, Fastmag ERP, Joolan).
xp1.mission5: Client technical support, custom integrations, and Docker development environments setup.
xp1.opinion: I joined an incredibly welcoming team, with a warm and almost family-like atmosphere. The projects are stimulating, driven by modern and exciting technologies, offering great learning opportunities. A motivating environment in which to evolve!

xp2.title: Internship - 2nd Year BTS SIO option SLAM
xp2.desc: Development and maintenance of a complete software solution.
xp2.mission1: Techs: In-house framework (EzFrame) based on Symfony, PHP, JQUERY, TWIG, Ajax and Bootstrap5.
xp2.mission2: Implementation of an offer creation feature with a stepper (Smart Wizard) and PDF generation.
xp2.mission4: Agile Scrum methodology, participation in daily meetings and 3-week sprints (planning, review, and retrospective).
xp2.opinion: A very enriching experience, where I was able to develop my technical skills and learn to work in an agile environment. The collaboration with the team was very pleasant, and I was able to take part in important projects.

xp3.title: Internship - 1st Year BTS SIO option SLAM
xp3.desc: JS training, mini projects in JS and static site.
xp3.mission1: Techs: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Figma.
xp3.mission2: Implementing a static site based on a pre-defined layout.
xp3.opinion: This internship was a highly educational first experience, where I learned the basics of front-end web development and the implementation of static sites. The collaboration with my team was constructive and allowed me to acquire solid skills.

xp4.title: Student Job - Manutention (Temporary Work)
xp4.opinion: A useful experience for learning teamwork and managing practical tasks. Although this work is not directly related to computer science, it allowed me to develop organizational and time management skills.

xp5.title: Observation Internship (3rd Year Secondary School) - Vignoble Ducourt
xp5.mission1: Observation of the different stages of wine production.
xp5.mission2: Learning about professions related to wine production.
xp5.opinion: A pleasant experience that allowed me to discover the work environment for the first time, which was very enriching. Although this internship was not directly related to my career in IT, it gave me perspective on working in a rural environment.
